expectation: Membrane ring on a subset of CD3E+ T cells (cytotoxic), plus some dimmer NK cells. Moderately common, scattered single cells, enriched in T-cell zones and in epithelium as intraepithelial lymphocytes. Not on every cell.
observed: A: tissue has diffuse yellow haze, with scattered bright dots. B: distinct ring-shaped cells on a hazy background. C: bright ring cells line the epithelium like intraepithelial lymphocytes. D: bright, blurry clusters. E: CD8a rings sit on a subset of CD3E+ cells, with some CD8a-only cells.
why: Discrete membrane-ringed cells in B, C and E3 form a subset of CD3E+ cells and line the epithelium, despite the background haze.
